AttributeConfigMetaModel.description: Attribute config metadata (name, annotations, labels, tags).

name.description: Unique name for this attribute schema document.

AttributeConfigSpecModel.description: An attribute schema's target binding plus the real JSON Schema fragment.

target.description:
What this schema validates.

Rules:
- `block: composite` requires `view: effective`.
- With `view: document`, the block must exist on the targeted kind. Blocks per kind: artifact: configuration, custom, properties; deployment: custom, properties; environment: custom, features, properties, variables; firewall: configuration, custom; integration: configuration, custom; module: configuration, custom; namespace: configuration, custom; parameterset: values; provider: configuration, custom; resource: configuration, custom; tenant: configuration, custom, properties; workspace: configuration, custom, properties.
- `view: effective` is only valid with `kind: deployment` and a block of composite, custom, features, params, properties, variables, or with `kind: environment` or `tenant` and `block: params`.

schema.description: The JSON Schema (2020-12) the block must satisfy, written as ordinary JSON Schema without any strata-specific keywords. A `$ref` to a remote document is not fetched.

AttributeConfigTargetModel.description:
What an attribute schema applies to: a `kind`, one free-form `block` of it, optionally narrowed by a `selector`, evaluated in a `view`.

Rules:
- `block: composite` requires `view: effective`.
- With `view: document`, the block must exist on the targeted kind. Blocks per kind: artifact: configuration, custom, properties; deployment: custom, properties; environment: custom, features, properties, variables; firewall: configuration, custom; integration: configuration, custom; module: configuration, custom; namespace: configuration, custom; parameterset: values; provider: configuration, custom; resource: configuration, custom; tenant: configuration, custom, properties; workspace: configuration, custom, properties.
- `view: effective` is only valid with `kind: deployment` and a block of composite, custom, features, params, properties, variables, or with `kind: environment` or `tenant` and `block: params`.

kind.description: The kind of document this schema targets (e.g. 'environment').

block.description: Which free-form block of the targeted kind to validate. `composite` (only with `view: effective`) validates one object holding the merged `properties`, `custom`, `variables` and `features` together, for rules that span blocks. `values` is a parameter set's own values (`view: document`). `params` (only with `view: effective`, for a deployment, environment or tenant) is the parameter-set values the document receives once its chain's sets are merged, one top-level key per role. `secrets` is deliberately not allowed, because a failure message could echo the secret value.

selector.description: Optional field-path to required-value constraints, for example `{spec.provider_type: azure}`. Omit to match every document of `kind`. Equality only: no wildcards or regex.

view.description: Required, no default: the two views check different data. 'document': evaluate each matching document's own block in isolation. 'effective': evaluate the merged `properties`/`custom`/`variables`/`features` of each deployable deployment instead — only valid for `kind: deployment` — or, with `block: params`, the merged parameter-set values of each deployable deployment, environment or tenant.

description: A JSON Schema that validates a free-form block (`properties`, `custom`, `configuration`, `variables` or `features`) of every document of a kind, optionally filtered by a selector. Use it to type-check otherwise free-form values, for example requiring `account_tier` on every Azure storage account resource.

meta.description: Attribute config metadata (name, annotations, labels, tags)
